meta.title: A Next-Generation 3D Tissue-Engineered Model of the Human Brain Microvasculature to Study the Blood-Brain Barrier.

extracted_by: Claude (Claude Code session), pending human review
summary: A 3D-printed perfusable microvessel scaffold modelling the human blood-brain barrier; endothelial cells and pericytes were seeded into the lumens after printing, so no cell-laden bioink was printed.
